CREATE OR ALTER VIEW Bronze.vw_contoso_customer
AS
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT 
        [CustomerKey],
        [GeoAreaKey],
        [StartDT],
        [EndDT],
        [Continent],
        [Gender],
        [Title],
        [GivenName],
        [MiddleInitial],
        [Surname],
        [StreetAddress],
        [City],
        [State],
        [StateFull],
        [ZipCode],
        [Country],
        [CountryFull],
        [Birthday],
        [Age],
        [Occupation],
        [Company],
        [Vehicle],
        [Latitude],
        [Longitude],
        [row_hash],
        [bronze_watermark],
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY CustomerKey 
            ORDER BY [bronze_watermark] DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'contoso/customer/*/*.parquet',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'bronze',
        FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
    ) AS src  
) AS t  
WHERE rn = 1;
